forcedChoices.choice: tú between the collector and Peter
forcedChoices.reason: Packet rule: one person speaking to one person uses tú.
Spanish has no separate natural vocative; same word as the glossary form for Master.
The meeting follows the afternoon public meeting; «tarde» would blur it with the afternoon.
Earlier-paper glossary forms keep the three English words apart.
«elevado» keeps both readings of «lifted up» (raised on the cross, exalted) open.

forcedChoices.choice: «cuando huyó», «cuando se negó» with no named subject
forcedChoices.reason: English «he» can be Jesus or Judas; the Spanish keeps the same ambiguity.
